note: Bound real pin. source_commit/tree identify the fixed consumer revision; source_files_sha256 covers the loader, its decision_access/fact_contracts/values closure and the generated v2 schema, each verified byte-for-byte before the module is imported. Two digest surfaces stay distinct: p12_package_digests is the account binding identity digest(_package_content(validated)) - what the real P12 ConfigurationBinding records; p12_wire_digests is the loader's own digest over the raw wire bytes. Neither is the file sha256, and the wire digest never substitutes for the account binding digest.
